  Duration: 1h15 | Cost: €0

- 12:00 — [Lunch in Monti (neighbourhood restaurants / enoteca)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lunch+in+Monti+%28neighbourhood+restaurants+%2F+enoteca%29+Rome) — Tip: Monti has excellent mid-range trattorie and wine bars.

- 13:45 — [Capitoline Museums or relaxed exploration of Roman Forum surrounds](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Capitoline+Museums+or+relaxed+exploration+of+Roman+Forum+surrounds+Rome) — Tip: Choose museums or a slow café break depending on energy.

# Rome — 4-day food & culture itinerary (couple, mid-range)

Day 1 — Arrival & historic-centre stroll (easy first day) — Total: €78 per person
- 09:00 — [Settle at hotel + coffee](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Settle+at+hotel+%2B+coffee+Rome) — Tip: Check in, drop bags and get oriented.  
  Duration: 1h | Cost: €5
- 10:30 — [Walk: Spanish Steps → Trevi Fountain](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Walk%3A+Spanish+Steps+%E2%86%92+Trevi+Fountain+Rome) — Tip: Leisurely walk for photos and a little shopping.  
  Duration: 1h | Cost: €0
- 12:00 — [Gelato & light lunch near Pantheon](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gelato+%26+light+lunch+near+Pantheon+Rome) — Tip: Try a gelato by the Pantheon for an easy, tasty lunch.  
  Duration: 1h15 | Cost: €20
- 13:30 — [Pantheon & Piazza Navona](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pantheon+%26+Piazza+Navona+Rome) — Tip: Visit the Pantheon interior and enjoy the piazza atmosphere.  
  Duration: 1h15 | Cost: €0
- 15:00 — [Coffee / downtime at Campo de' Fiori](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Coffee+%2F+downtime+at+Campo+de%27+Fiori+Rome) — Tip: People-watch and rest—good mid-afternoon pause.  
  Duration: 1h | Cost: €8
- 16:30 — [Walk to Trastevere (transfer)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Walk+to+Trastevere+%28transfer%29+Rome) — Tip: Short and pleasant transfer to an evening-food neighborhood.  
  Duration: 25m | Cost: €0
- 19:30 — [Dinner in Trastevere (traditional trattoria)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dinner+in+Trastevere+%28traditional+trattoria%29+Rome) — Tip: Reserve ahead for popular trattorie.  
  Duration: 2h | Cost: €45

Day 2 — Ancient Rome: Colosseum, Forum & neighbourhood flavours — Total: €113 per person
- 08:30 — [Book ahead: Colosseum + Roman Forum + Palatine Hill](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Book+ahead%3A+Colosseum+%2B+Roman+Forum+%2B+Palatine+Hill+Rome) — Tip: Timed entry—arrive ~20 min early to pass security.  
  Duration: 2h30 | Cost: €18
- 11:30 — [Walk up to Capitoline Hill / viewpoint (short transfer)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Walk+up+to+Capitoline+Hill+%2F+viewpoint+%28short+transfer%29+Rome) — Tip: Great city views and photos after the Forum.  
  Duration: 20m | Cost: €0
- 12:00 — [Lunch in Monti (neighbourhood restaurants / enoteca)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lunch+in+Monti+%28neighbourhood+restaurants+%2F+enoteca%29+Rome) — Tip: Monti has excellent mid-range trattorie and wine bars.  
  Duration: 1h15 | Cost: €30
- 13:45 — [Capitoline Museums or relaxed exploration of Roman Forum surrounds](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Capitoline+Museums+or+relaxed+exploration+of+Roman+Forum+surrounds+Rome) — Tip: Choose museums or a slow café break depending on energy.  
  Duration: 1h30 | Cost: €15
- 16:15 — [Coffee & gelato break (downtime)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Coffee+%26+gelato+break+%28downtime%29+Rome) — Tip: Recharge with coffee + gelato after lots of walking.  
  Duration: 45m | Cost: €8
- 18:00 — [Transfer to Testaccio for evening (short taxi/tram)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Transfer+to+Testaccio+for+evening+%28short+taxi%2Ftram%29+Rome) — Tip: Short trip to a top food-focused neighborhood.  
  Duration: 20m | Cost: €2
- 19:00 — [Dinner / food market tasting in Testaccio](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dinner+%2F+food+market+tasting+in+Testaccio+Rome) — Tip: Sample local Roman dishes and market specialties.  
  Duration: 2h | Cost: €40

Day 3 — Vatican highlights & riverside strolls — Total: €132 per person
- 09:00 — [Book ahead: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Book+ahead%3A+Vatican+Museums+%26+Sistine+Chapel+Rome) — Tip: Timed-entry essential to avoid long queues.  
  Duration: 2h30 | Cost: €20
- 12:30 — [St. Peter's Basilica (visit interior; optional dome climb)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St.+Peter%27s+Basilica+%28visit+interior%3B+optional+dome+climb%29+Rome) — Tip: Basilica is free; dome climb costs extra (~€8–10).  
  Duration: 1h30 | Cost: €0
- 14:30 — [Lunch in Prati (near the Vatican)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lunch+in+Prati+%28near+the+Vatican%29+Rome) — Tip: Prati has many trattorie and good wine lists.  
  Duration: 1h15 | Cost: €35
- 16:00 — [Castel Sant'Angelo & Tiber riverside walk](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Castel+Sant%27Angelo+%26+Tiber+riverside+walk+Rome) — Tip: Choose the castle visit or a relaxed riverside stroll.  
  Duration: 1h30 | Cost: €12
- 18:30 — [Aperitivo / early evening wine in Piazza Navona or riverside bar](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Aperitivo+%2F+early+evening+wine+in+Piazza+Navona+or+riverside+bar+Rome) — Tip: Enjoy an aperitivo to unwind before dinner.  
  Duration: 1h30 | Cost: €20
- 20:30 — [Dinner in central Rome (choose a spot you reserved)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dinner+in+central+Rome+%28choose+a+spot+you+reserved%29+Rome) — Tip: Book ahead for popular central restaurants.  
  Duration: 2h | Cost: €45

Day 4 — Borghese art, Villa Borghese park & a food finale — Total: €155 per person
- 09:00 — [Book ahead: Galleria Borghese (timed entry)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Book+ahead%3A+Galleria+Borghese+%28timed+entry%29+Rome) — Tip: Timed slots required—arrive 10–15 min early.  
  Duration: 1h30 | Cost: €20
- 11:00 — [Villa Borghese park: relax, small boat rental or bike ride](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Villa+Borghese+park%3A+relax%2C+small+boat+rental+or+bike+ride+Rome) — Tip: Great mellow time after the museum—rent a bike or a pedal boat.  
  Duration: 1h30 | Cost: €10
- 13:00 — [Lunch near the park](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lunch+near+the+park+Rome) — Tip: Keep it relaxed before the afternoon food activity.  
  Duration: 1h15 | Cost: €30
- 15:00 — [Testaccio food market visit or half-day cooking class](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Testaccio+food+market+visit+or+half-day+cooking+class+Rome) — Tip: Book a cooking class in advance or explore market tastings.  
  Duration: 2h30 | Cost: €50
- 18:45 — [Return to hotel to freshen up (transfer)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Return+to+hotel+to+freshen+up+%28transfer%29+Rome) — Tip: Short rest before your farewell dinner.  
  Duration: 30m | Cost: €0
- 20:00 — [Farewell dinner in the Jewish Ghetto or Trastevere](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Farewell+dinner+in+the+Jewish+Ghetto+or+Trastevere+Rome) — Tip: Try carciofi alla giudia if in season in the Ghetto.  
  Duration: 2h | Cost: €45

Grand total: €478 per person
